create_bpstate: create a BPState container with log_potentials, ftov_msgs, and evidence from the same factor graph state
update_log_potentials: update log potentials for factor groups in a JIT-compiled belief propagation state
update_ftov_msgs: update factor-to-variable messages for variables or factor types in a JIT-compiled belief propagation state
update_evidence: update evidence values for variables or variable groups in a JIT-compiled belief propagation state
build_logpotentials: build a LogPotentials container to store and manipulate log potentials with factor group indexing
